name: Unity
overview: Scripture reveals that unity is both a divine blessing and a powerful testimony to the world, exemplified by the harmony among believers and the intimate oneness within the Godhead. The psalmist celebrates the goodness of brethren dwelling together in unity, while Isaiah depicts watchmen singing together in agreement, symbolizing shared vision and purpose. Jesus teaches that all believers are brothers under one Master, and He emphasizes that love among His followers will identify them as His disciples. The early church demonstrated unity through their shared hearts and possessions, reflecting a deep spiritual and communal bond. Ultimately, Christ’s prayer in John 17 highlights that believers are made perfect in oneness, mirroring the unity between the Father and the Son.
